ambient: The grass moves in a wind that isn't on your face.
A bird goes over and doesn't arrive anywhere.
The light changes to a different hour without passing through the ones between.
description: Grass to the knee, grey-green, going on to a horizon nearer than a horizon should be. Behind you is the city, correctly, in every detail, including the parts you have never seen. Ahead is the edge. It isn't a cliff. It's where the description stops.
name: The Field At The Edge Of It

looks: Not a drop. The grass simply stops being described.
You walk toward it a while. It keeps its distance, courteously.
There's something on the other side of it, doing something patient.
objects.name: the edge

looks: Every window lit, and rendered, and correct.
It's nearer than it was, and it hasn't moved.
You know the inside of a building you have never entered. All of them.
objects.name: the city behind you

weather: The grass moves in a wind that never reaches your face. Above it the sky is the colour of a lit room.
